review_method: Source-order full read: Japanese semantic authority, pinned English handling/reason, Korean accuracy/naturalness/register/terminology/localization. 1200 directly reviewed accepted IDs, 61 EDIT and 1139 KEEP, no exclusions and no propagation. Official Korean surface terms and the pinned English patch localization strategy were used as consistency baselines. Candidate rows were directly checked against current Korean before materialization; four proposal no-ops already matching the intended Korean were retained as KEEP rather than counted as edits.
